notes.microbatch: 128 x 1 replaces Track O's 16 x 8. Measured 1,300 MiB peak and 1.44x faster than 16 x 8 before the featuriser work; the loss is a per-episode mean then a batch mean and each accumulated chunk is divided by the chunk count, so the two shapes are loss-equivalent by construction. Pinned by tests/test_read_run_training_v3.py::test_microbatch_shape_is_loss_equivalent.
notes.evaluation_microbatch_size: Separate from the training microbatch on purpose. The Track O probe reused one value for both, so widening training would have silently widened evaluation; evaluation stays at Track O's 16.
notes.expected_target_count: Deleted, not set to 2. Track O's config carried it and model_v2.coverage_features encoded it three times, which is why a stop head reading those features could only rediscover stop_aware's hard-coded rule. model_v3.stop_features contains no target constant and tests/test_read_run_model_v3.py asserts no column saturates as the endpoint count varies.
notes.supervision_schedule: on_policy for the whole run. Track O's gold phase is dropped, and so is the walker phase. Measured before any Track P result was read: a gold walk expands exactly the two planted route prefixes, so both target endpoints register during its final expansion and no decision point ever observes the walk as complete — the stop label is 0 at every decision point of every episode, structurally, on both cells (0/212 and 0/228 decision points over 48 episodes each). A stop head trained on that reaches 1.000 label agreement by predicting the constant 'never stop'. On-policy exhaustive walks give 7-9% positive decision points, which is the signal the head needs. Under exhaustion on-policy also examines the whole relation-matching prefix tree, a superset of the route prefixes gold supplies, so dropping gold removes no edge-loss data.
notes.loss_weights: Three separately supervised heads with exactly derivable labels, so the mixture changes how fast each converges, never where. This is not the budget-versus-coverage trade-off design note 2.16 rules out: no weight here sets an operating point on a single quantity.
notes.training_walk_stop_rule: Training always exhausts and ignores the stop head's own output, which decouples what that head learns from what it does and yields decision points on both sides of route-completeness.
